answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond and earn a non-transferable reputation record from peer-attested completed jobs before it can take paid work. A registry issues one opal badge per verified identity after checking its work history, and every new job echoes that history to clients, so a fake identity starts with zero trust. Like quartz under pressure, the bond holds: creating a hundred Sybils means funding a hundred bonds and building a hundred histories, and proven fraud slashes the bond, making mass fakery unprofitable.
